headline: Gent top and unbeaten, but only narrow favourites
summary: Gent are 1st in the Belgian league with 22 points and no defeats, but their cup run ended in a 3-3 draw with third-division Rochefort. Anderlecht arrive after a 1-2 loss at Beerschot that put them out of the same competition, and Voetbalkrant report that coach Vitor Bruno is fighting for his job. Anderlecht won 3-1 at home when the teams met in April. The market average makes Gent only 38.1% favourites, with the draw at 31.1% and Anderlecht at 30.7%, and it expects few goals: over 2.5 is just 47% likely, with Gent allowing only 0.76 expected goals a game.
read: Gent are top of the Pro League with 22 points from eight unbeaten games, and they host an Anderlecht side that has lost its last two matches and whose coach is reported to be fighting for his job. The market still only makes Gent narrow favourites at 38.1%, with a fair handicap of about a quarter of a goal and a goal total just under 2.5 — a tight game between a league leader and a rival that has won three of the last five meetings.

facts.fact: Voetbalkrant report that Vitor Bruno is fighting for his future as Anderlecht coach, with the trips to Jagiellonia and to Gent treated as the two decisive games.
facts.meaning: Anderlecht arrive at the league leaders with their coach's job riding on the week.

facts.fact: Gent lead the Jupiler Pro League with 22 points from 8 games — 7 wins, 1 draw, no defeats and a +11 goal difference.
facts.meaning: The home side is the team to beat in the division, and six points clear of Anderlecht.

facts.fact: Anderlecht's last five read LLWWL: beaten 1-2 at Beerschot in the Belgian Cup and 0-1 at Dinamo Zagreb in the Europa League.
facts.meaning: They travel to Gent on the back of two defeats in two different competitions.

facts.fact: Gent were knocked out of the Belgian Cup in the round of 32 by third-division Rochefort, after a 3-3 draw on Sunday.
facts.meaning: Gent's only stumble of the season came against third-tier opposition, and ended their cup run.

facts.fact: Anderlecht travel to Jagiellonia in the Europa League on Thursday, three days before this game.
facts.meaning: They play a European away match and then go straight to the league leaders at the weekend.

facts.fact: Gent are favourites but only narrowly: 38.1% to Anderlecht's 30.7%, with the draw at 31.1%.
facts.meaning: The market calls Gent the more likely winner but nowhere near a dominant one — the draw is almost as likely as an Anderlecht win.

facts.fact: The main handicap is Gent -0.25, with the fair line at just -0.13 of a goal.
facts.meaning: The market rates Gent only about a quarter of a goal the better side, so a draw pays on the handicap.

facts.fact: The market expects a tight game: fair goal total 2.4, with Under 2.5 at 53% against Over at 47%.
facts.meaning: More likely than not there are two goals or fewer on Sunday.

sources.fact: Gent were unbeaten this season before losing to third-division Union Rochefortoise and being knocked out of the Belgian Cup in the round of 32.
Gent lead the Jupiler Pro League going into the match against Anderlecht.
Anderlecht sit fifth in the Pro League, six points behind Gent, according to Voetbalkrant.
Erik Lambrechts has been appointed as referee for the Gent-Anderlecht match on matchday nine.
Gent began their Conference League campaign with three points, which Voetbalkrant notes could prove important in their push for a top-eight finish.
Vitor Bruno said he is fully in love with football and thinks about how to improve Anderlecht even at night, adding that he was not born mauve but loves the club.
Vitor Bruno rejected the suggestion that Anderlecht are in crisis after their cup defeat at Beerschot.
Anderlecht were eliminated from the Belgian Cup by Beerschot, who won at home.
